raw.rationale: TG-101348 (fedratinib) is a JAK2/FLT3 inhibitor whose antiproliferative activity in PRISM is largely restricted to JAK2-dependent myeloproliferative neoplasms, which are not among the listed solid-tumor lineages; solid-tumor sensitivity is uncommon and lineage-selective killing at 2.5 µM is unlikely. Published PRISM/CTRP data show little selective activity across these lineages, so probabilities remain near the low base rate.
